queries.text: Acting as a senior hardware product manager, conduct in-depth research on tablet-style devices used for payments or SaaS applications. Your report should: 1) List major manufacturers, specific device models, and their configurations. 2) Include images of these devices. 3) Analyze the primary use cases and scenarios where these devices are deployed. 4) Investigate the market penetration, common usage scenarios, typical price ranges, and estimated installed base for such devices across different regions (North America, Japan/Korea, Southeast Asia, South America).
List of major manufacturers producing tablet-style devices specifically for payments or SaaS applications in 2023
Count of distinct device models released by Verifone, Ingenico, and PAX Technology for payment processing between 2019 and 2024
Specific hardware configurations (CPU, RAM, storage) for the latest generation mobile point-of-sale tablets from major vendors (1, 2, 3, 4, price)
Percentage share of global market held by top three POS terminal manufacturers in 2023
Primary use cases and deployment scenarios for standalone tablet-based payment terminals versus smartphone-attached readers (1, 2, 3, 4, price)
Share of retail transactions processed via dedicated handheld POS terminals compared to integrated counter-top systems in North America in 2022
Average selling price range for enterprise-grade payment tablets with built-in card readers
Median cost per unit for SaaS-focused field service tablets deployed in logistics sectors across Europe in 2021
Estimated installed base of active mobile payment terminals in North American retail locations as of Q4 2023
Count of registered devices on major payment processing platforms (e.g., Square, Toast) categorized by hardware type in the United States during 2023
Market penetration rate of cloud-based POS tablet solutions among small and medium-sized businesses in Japan
Percentage increase in adoption of standalone tablet POS systems versus traditional fixed terminals in South Korea from 2018 to 2023
